thread:
alice_support: Hey team, PSC (customer: acme.io) opened an escalation — sustained 502/504s for hosted API in us-east-1 for the last ~20m. They report streaming disconnects and high tail latency. :rotating_light:
customer_acme_io: Seeing ~15% requests 502 or 504, mainly on /v1/generate streaming endpoints. Happens during bursts, but also when single-request from their integration. No changes on their side.
alice_support: They provided a couple trace ids and a curl repro, dropping them here. trace=tr-0a9f3b; curl: `curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \"https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate\" -d '@/tmp/payload.json'` — response sometimes 502 mid-stream.
ben_sre: @carol_oncall jumping in. I see a slight spike in 5xx from edge in our ingestion metrics around 4850012200..4850012350. Correlates with ingress queue depth rising on envoy-frontend-us-east-1-a.
carol_oncall: Pulling envoy logs now. Early glance: increased upstream connect_time and several `upstream reset` + `timeout while connecting to upstream`. Might be upstream auth-proxy thrashing.
dave_eng: There was a small secrets rotation job at 4850012160 (KMS key roll). Deploy-bot said it completed okay. Could that cause auth backend to briefly fail while reloading keys?
deploy-bot: deploy: secrets-rotation-job finished at 4850012172; status=completed; affected-service=auth-proxy; rollout=hot-reload.
ben_sre: If auth-proxy dropped connections briefly, edge would return 502 when it can't get authz. But the mix of 502 and 504 + streaming disconnects hints at keepalive / connection pool exhaustion too.
maria_prodops: Also saw a small CPU bump on auth-proxy pods and refused connections metric ticked. I'll pull pod logs.
alice_support: Customer attached a simple repro sequence: start streaming generation with chunk_size=2048 and then upload a second parallel request. They see one of the streams die.
carol_oncall: Log snippet from envoy-frontend-us-east-1-a around 4850012228:
```
[4850012228] level=warn msg="upstream connection reset before response complete" request_id=tr-0a9f3b upstream=auth-proxy-5b7c
[4850012231] level=err msg="failed to connect to upstream: connection refused" request_id=tr-12c8d
[4850012235] level=warn msg="h2: GOAWAY received" worker=stream-17
```
```
Auth-proxy pod logs (auth-proxy-5b7c):
2026-05-02T12:03:40.123Z WARN auth: reload keys: brief k8s secret mount delay
2026-05-02T12:03:41.456Z ERROR http: accept tcp: backlog full
```
carol_oncall: That `backlog full` message is interesting — kernel accept queue overflow -> refused connects -> envoy sees resets -> 502s.
ben_sre: Root hypothesis: KMS/secret rotation caused a hot-reload that briefly starved the auth-proxy accept queue (process paused during reload), combined with a burst of streaming connections -> SYN backlog overflow -> connection refused -> 502s. The streaming long-lived connections then hit h2 windowing problems -> 504 for long poll requests.
dave_eng: Repro suggestion: run a small loop creating concurrent streaming requests while triggering a config reload on the auth-proxy (we can simulate by sending SIGHUP). If we can reproduce, we can test mitigation.
alice_support: Customer asked for immediate mitigation. Any quick fixes?
maria_prodops: Short term: scale auth-proxy replicas + increase `net.core.somaxconn` and `tcp_max_syn_backlog` in the auth-proxy nodes/template, and add a graceful drain hook so hot-reloads don't pause accept. Also add a connection pooling fallback at the edge for auth calls (cache short-lived tokens for 5s).\aroblem: (reaction) :thumbsup:
ben_sre: I'll bump replicas to +2 in us-east and roll a kernel param change via DaemonSet patch. Also enable a retry-on-5xx with jitter on the edge auth call for 200ms up to 2 attempts as a quick safety net.
carol_oncall: Performed scaling at 4850012287: auth-proxy replicas from 3 -> 6. Applied sysctl bump; rolling restart of pods with preStop sleep to allow existing accepts to drain.
deploy-bot: rollout: auth-proxy scale to 6 at 4850012287; sysctl-daemonset applied at 4850012294; preStop hook added to auth-proxy deployment.
alice_support: Customer confirmation: "we see errors dropping to <1% within ~3m after your scaling. Streaming now stable."
customer_acme_io: Confirmed — errors dropped and the streaming sessions resumed. Thanks for the fast response.
ben_sre: Follow-up action items: 1) Add graceful reload for auth-proxy (avoid dropping accept loop); 2) add short caching layer at edge for auth tokens to reduce auth-proxy pressure during reloads; 3) run chaos test simulating hot reload under burst to prevent regressions; 4) add metric alert on `accept queue full` and `auth-proxy refused connections`.
dave_eng: I'll own #1 and #3. Maria will own #2. Ben will own #4.
maria_prodops: Created follow-up ticket INF-8723: "edge auth caching + connection backoff during backend reload".
carol_oncall: Marking this thread resolved for the immediate incident at 4850012420. Will keep ticket open for follow-ups.
alice_support: Thanks everyone, filing post-incident summary to customer and noting timing in the support case. :white_check_mark:
